events.title: Agent policy authority centralized into one rules repo
events.epistemic_basis: Direct Git/filesystem inspection verified a private organicoverlords/agent-rules repository with default rules/live, central RULES/context files, retired local generated-policy machinery, pointer-only downstream rule files, and focused regressions for the new Atlas/all-branch model.

events.title: Memory writer main-branch publication trap contained on dedicated memory/live branch
events.epistemic_basis: The required memory record path published a04cdb1 directly to main because memory_git_sync.py hard-coded BRANCH=main. main then independently advanced to c6c17b6, making history rewrite unsafe. Exact a04cdb1 was preserved as memory/live; the repair candidate uses memory/live and rejects protected branches, and a repository-local pre-push guard immediately blocks direct protected-branch pushes.
